causebase_summary: 4LIFESKILLS INC. is an organisation based in Western Australia whose website states it provides personalised support services for young people and adults living with disability. The site lists a range of goal areas the organisation says it helps with, including looking after yourself and your home, building social skills and relationships, finding a rewarding career, taking short breaks or holidays, pursuing hobbies, and staying healthy and active. Website items describe specific activities for participants: a pottery session for Rockingham participants, support for an artist named Lesley to share her work, and a feature called “A Day with Gina” about daily support for independence and connections. The website also promotes corporate sponsorship as a way to support its work. The organisation’s 2022–23 annual information statement reports revenue of AUD 6,957,588 and expenses of AUD 7,115,503. The available evidence is primarily the organisation’s website and its ACNC reporting extract; the website frames services as personalised and person-centred but does not provide detailed participant counts or independent verification of outcomes.
